title: NEON breeding landbird point counts, RELEASE-2026, as distance-sampling cells: clusters of 46 common species in four radial-distance bins per 6-minute count at 3434 points across 47 NEON sites, 2013-2024
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Breeding landbird point counts (DP1.10003.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/v6hs-mx57. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.10003.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-02
abstract: NEON's breeding landbird point counts record the radial distance (laser rangefinder) of every detected individual or cluster. This table bins those distances to four cells (0-25, 25-50, 50-100, 100-1000 m) per count for the 46 species with at least 2000 detected clusters over the release: y = clusters first detected in the bin, obs_individuals = individuals in them, every shipped species at every count. The sibling table neon_2026_landbirds_count carries the per-count totals for 283 species.
samplingProtocol: 6-minute unlimited-radius point counts between dawn and 3.5 h after sunrise, May-July, by trained observers; each individual or cluster recorded with minute of first detection, radial distance (laser rangefinder), detection method and cluster size; one or two bouts per year (NEON TOS protocol for breeding landbird sampling)
surveyEvidenceNote: brd_perpoint lists every point-count event; a count exists iff samplingImpractical == OK and at least one brd_countdata row. Species pool is national: every shipped species at every count.
closureNote: occasion = distance bin of one count; period = the count event (year x bout), 1-2 per point per year
geographicCoverage: 47 NEON terrestrial sites in 20 domains, continental USA, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico; point coordinates as published by NEON (WGS 84) in __units; latitude 18.0 to 71.3, longitude -156.6 to -66.8

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published by NEON (agency-published point coordinates); no coarsening. Species of concern are already reported by NEON at a higher taxonomic rank ('fuzzed') or withheld at some sites, and those records are not shipped

occasionLength: 6 minutes (the count); occasion indexes the distance bin

components.neon_2026_landbirds_count: per-count individuals of 283 species (count), same events and units

covariateNote: obs_individuals = individuals in the bin's clusters; obs_air_temp_c, obs_wind_kmh, obs_cloud_pct, obs_rh_pct, obs_habitat per count; point-level facts in __units. NEON publishes the grid centre for the nine points of a bird grid (coordinateUncertaintyInMeters ~250 m), so points of one grid share coordinates; single-point arrays carry the point itself.
notes: Distances are deposited to the metre and binned here (0, 25, 50, 100, 1000 m); drop occasion 4 to truncate at 100 m. A cluster is placed by its first record (clusterCode across minutes). Period is the count event (year x bout), so a dynamic model by year needs __periods$year. 271 clusters of the shipped species had no recorded distance and are dropped. Removal-sampling information (pointCountMinute) is not carried.

notShipped.clusters without a distance: 271 of the shipped species (962 over all species)
notShipped.species below the cut: 498 species with fewer than 2000 clusters (in the count table when >= 100)
